bayts.text: I have praised Him Who guards me from the harm of every devil, jinn and human.
Glory be to Him, Lord and Preserver: I shelter in His keeping from affliction and punishments.
In Him I take refuge from my passion and from the Accursed, and from all harmful (creatures), from every evil eye.
I have intended to call upon Him seeking intercession by the rank of His beloved, the intercessor of intercessors,
Aḥmad, master of creatures, blessing him, (I) who seek through him access to my Lord.
I ask my Lord, by his rank, for deliverance from misfortunes and from the strife of oppressors.
To You (belong) the creatures, O Lord: grant me protection from them and from every affliction and punishment.
To You, O Preserver (Al-Ḥafīẓ), I have entrusted my soul as a deposit: You are ever my intimacy.
Grant me what I love in the two Abodes, and in them guard me from the two disgraces.
I have turned my face to You, Lord, together with my means of access (the Prophet), and that suffices me.
Save my person from all that grieves, and keep from me all that whispers.
Turn the enemies away from me, all of them, through the Prophet and the people of Badr, the noble, the elect.
Grant me to enter, dwelling at peace, into Your impregnable fortress, safe from them.
You are He Who guards whoever holds fast to You from every punishment that aims at him.
To You I entrust my affairs forever, and whoever takes refuge in You is not turned away.
You have guarded me, O Beneficent (Al-Barr), from disbelief: so guard me from the harm of its people and from every trial.
Hold back from me the hands of the associators, through the people of Badr, and make them my fortress.
O Beneficent, be for me and do not put me to shame, in this world and the next, and pass over (my faults).
For the Chosen One write blessing and peace, with his Family and his Companions, in perpetuity.
